clue.text: Distinguishing feature of hotel brand accommodating everybody

indicators.note: accommodating means giving room to, so the hotel-and-brand letters take another word inside them

parts.note: H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a brand is a mark burned or stamped on something
everybody means all

explanation.surface: A hotel chain's signature trait is that it welcomes all guests.
explanation.definitionFit: A hallmark is a stamp of quality and by extension any characteristic trait.

clue.text: Sailors paid, oddly, in anticipation for dance

indicators.note: in places the sailors and odd letters within the anticipation word

parts.note: hope is anticipation of something good
RN, the Royal Navy, stands for sailors

indicators.note: oddly picks the first and third letters of paid

explanation.surface: Sailors, paid only in part, dance in hope of the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A hornpipe is a lively solo dance traditionally associated with sailors.

clue.text: Diamonds stolen from landowner's hiding places

indicators.note: stolen from means taken away, so a letter disappears from the landowner word

parts.note: a laird is a Scottish landowner; with the possessive it gives these letters
D is the card-suit abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: Jewels taken from a landowner's secret stashes.
explanation.definitionFit: Lairs are dens where animals or fugitives hide.

clue.text: Cosmetic used by nameless man covering a sign of injury

indicators.note: covering means wrapping round, so the trimmed man word goes round the other letters
nameless means without N, the abbreviation for name

parts.note: taken as written before losing its N
a scar is a lasting sign of an injury

explanation.surface: An anonymous man uses make-up to cover up a wound mark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nameless' is a deletion signal: N is the standard abbreviation for name.
explanation.definitionFit: Mascara is make-up applied to the eyelashes.

clue.text: Decay surrounding old part of tooth

indicators.note: surrounding means going round, so the decay word encloses a letter

parts.note: rot is decay

explanation.surface: Decay spreading around an old part of a tooth.
explanation.definitionFit: The root is the portion of a tooth embedded in the jaw.

clue.text: Clever clogs losing shoe, feels pain

indicators.note: losing means a part is dropped, here the footwear word from the know-all

parts.note: smartboots is an informal term for a know-all, like clever clogs
a boot is a kind of shoe

explanation.surface: A know-all who has lost a shoe is now in discomfort.
explanation.walkthrough: SMARTBOOTS, a jokey name for a know-all, loses BOOT.
explanation.definitionFit: To smart is to sting or hurt, so it smarts means it feels pain.

clue.text: Souvenir pieces impounded by London police ring

indicators.note: impounded by means locked up inside, so the police word holds the pieces word

parts.note: the Met is the Metropolitan Police of London
chessmen are pieces, so men means pieces
O looks like a ring

explanation.surface: London police seize souvenir items in a ring.
explanation.definitionFit: A memento is a keepsake kept to remember something by.

clue.text: Doctor ordering triages between runs

indicators.note: between places the scrambled letters inside the two run letters

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs, taken twice for the plural

indicators.note: ordering signals the letters of triages are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A doctor sorts out triage cases between ward rounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' looks like the anagram signal, but it is the definition, in the British sense of a hospital grade; 'ordering' does the shuffling.
explanation.definitionFit: A registrar is a senior hospital doctor in British medicine, below consultant grade.

clue.text: Thin European crushed by boxes

indicators.note: crushed by places one letter under the other in a down entry, beneath the boxes word

parts.note: to spar is to box, so spars means boxes

explanation.surface: A skinny European is flattened by a boxer.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparse means scanty, thinly spread.

clue.text: Mental aberration dismissing start of balmy weather event

indicators.note: dismissing means sending away, so a letter is removed from the mental-lapse word

parts.note: a brainstorm is a sudden mental lapse or aberration

indicators.note: start of means only the opening letter of balmy is used

explanation.surface: A sudden fit of madness ends a period of balmy weather.
explanation.definitionFit: A downpour with wind is a classic example of a weather event.

clue.text: Colour in detail on game having been given a lift

indicators.note: lifted upwards in a down entry means the letters read bottom to top
in says the letters lie inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across these words

explanation.surface: Colour detail added to a game that has been boosted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' points inside 'detail on game'; 'having been given a lift' reads that run upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Magnolia is a creamy off-white paint shade named after the flower.

clue.text: Pair of mothers welcoming good soft rock

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in a guest, so one letter goes inside the mothers' letters
pair of means the word for mother appears twice

parts.note: ma is an informal word for a mother

explanation.surface: Two mothers welcome some gentle rock music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soft rock' looks like a music genre; here it is molten rock.
explanation.definitionFit: Magma is molten, hence soft, rock beneath the earth's surface.

clue.text: Job facing a student of letters

parts.note: a post is a job or position
L for learner, the learner-driver plate, stands for a student

explanation.surface: A post awaits a student of literature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'student of letters' reads as a literature scholar; the definition is just 'of letters', meaning mail.
explanation.definitionFit: Postal describes anything relating to the mail, that is, letters sent.

clue.text: Suffers from a case of gas, stifling horrible noise

indicators.note: stifling means smothering, so the outer letters wrap round the scrambled noise
case of means the outside letters of gas, its casing
horrible signals the letters of noise are mangled into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone with trapped wind suffers, holding in a horrible noise.
explanation.definitionFit: To agonise is to suffer anguish or torment.

clue.text: Unfortunately it's a dopy state that's as far from perfection as possible

definitions.text: state that's as far from perfection as possible

indicators.note: unfortunately suggests things have gone wrong, so the letters of it's a dopy are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: Sadly it's a foolish place, as bad as it gets.
explanation.definitionFit: A dystopia is an imagined society that is the opposite of a utopia.

clue.text: First go red and blue for example

parts.note: primary means first in order
to colour is to blush, to go red in the face

explanation.surface: A list of colours where red comes first and blue follows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'red and blue' looks like the definition, but 'go red' is the wordplay and only 'blue for example' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue is one of the three basic hues from which painters mix all others.

clue.text: Trouble with a kid being uncomfortable

parts.note: ill means trouble or harm, as in ill befalls
to kid is to tease

explanation.surface: A parent's bother with a child who feels uneasy.
explanation.definitionFit: Being ill at ease means feeling awkward or uncomfortable.

clue.text: Cleverly laid Tory off

indicators.note: off means wrong or not right, so the letters of laid Tory are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Conservative politician is shrewdly dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: Adroitly means skilfully, deftly.

clue.text: Liable to steal clear and end grief, possibly

parts.note: light means clear or bright, as in a light room

indicators.note: possibly says the letters of end grief could be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A plea to clear up and stop grieving, perhaps.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone light-fingered is a pickpocket or petty thief, quick with the hands.

clue.text: Chap concealing weapon must get something to wear

indicators.note: concealing means hiding inside, so the chap word holds the weapon word

parts.note: a gent is a chap
an arm is a weapon

explanation.surface: A man hiding a gun needs an item of clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A garment is an article of clothing.

clue.text: Stone from Ulster incorporated into fireplace

indicators.note: incorporated into means placed inside, so the Ulster letters go into the fireplace word

parts.note: a grate is the fireplace's metal frame
NI, Northern Ireland, is often called Ulster

explanation.surface: Irish stone built into a hearth.
explanation.definitionFit: Granite is a hard igneous rock.

clue.text: Confused situation resulting from gold found in abundance

indicators.note: found in means located inside, so the gold letters sit within the abundance word

parts.note: a mass is a large amount, an abundance
OR is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Plenty of gold causes a muddle.
explanation.definitionFit: A morass is a muddle or complicated mess, literally a bog.

clue.text: Isolated appearances reveal cuts

parts.note: to out someone is to reveal their secret
to crop is to cut short

explanation.surface: Rare public sightings expose the cuts made.
explanation.definitionFit: Outcrops are rocks showing at the surface in isolated patches, appearances of bedrock.

clue.text: Military display work on body

definitions.meaning: an evening parade of marching bands and soldiers, as at Edinburgh
inked artwork applied to someone's skin

explanation.surface: Soldiers parade, then get inked.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses: a military evening show with drums, and a permanent design inked into skin.

clue.text: What doctor will do for delicacy?

definitions.meaning: a physician gives medical care to a patient
a delicacy is a special food, a luxury

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark marks the first sense as a definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: To treat is to give medical care; a treat is a special delight such as a tasty morsel.

clue.text: Parrot's speech offensive to some extent

indicators.note: to some extent says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A parrot's talk is rather rude.
explanation.definitionFit: To parrot is to repeat mindlessly; parrot's here is 'parrot is', a verb like echoes.

clue.text: Conscious of a revolutionary green source of energy

indicators.note: revolutionary means turned around, so the word for green is read backwards

parts.note: green means raw, inexperienced

indicators.note: source of means the first letter of energy

explanation.surface: Mindful of a radical green energy supply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary green' sounds political; it turns RAW into WAR.
explanation.definitionFit: To be aware of something is to know of it, to be conscious of it.

clue.text: Designer needing skill to incorporate hectic working

indicators.note: to incorporate means to take inside, so the skill word holds the scrambled letters

parts.note: art means skill, as in the art of persuasion

indicators.note: working signals the letters of hectic are worked into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A designer needs talent to cope with frantic work.
explanation.definitionFit: An architect designs buildings.

clue.text: Works hard to see constituencies adopting women

indicators.note: adopting means taking in, so the constituencies word takes in a letter

parts.note: parliamentary constituencies are seats

explanation.surface: A party toils to see constituencies choosing female candidates.
explanation.definitionFit: To sweat over something is to labour at it hard.

clue.text: Scientific study encompassing many branches

parts.note: a field of science with many sub-branches, but literally a science whose subject is full of tree branches

explanation.surface: A broad discipline with many sub-fields.
explanation.walkthrough: 'branches' seems to mean subdivisions of a subject; it is the boughs of trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Forestry is the science of managing woodland, whose trees bear countless boughs.
